description.en: Mistral's first-party API: OpenAI and Responses arms, embeddings, model catalog and the API and Vibe monthly budgets.
description.zh: Mistral 第一方 API：OpenAI / Responses 双协议、向量、模型目录与 API / Vibe 双额度。

docs.en: Paste an API key issued by La Plateforme. This package talks to api.mistral.ai on the chat/completions and responses arms, and polls the account's plan and its API and Vibe budgets.
docs.zh: 填入 La Plateforme 签发的 API Key。本包把 chat/completions 与 responses 直连 api.mistral.ai，并轮询账户的套餐与 API / Vibe 双额度。

description.en: Paste the API key issued by the La Plateforme console.
description.zh: 粘贴 La Plateforme 控制台签发的 API Key。

help_text.en: Create one under API Keys in console.mistral.ai.
help_text.zh: 在 console.mistral.ai 的 API Keys 页创建。
